content:
I would like to bring attention to batteries#1830 which aims to consolidate both environment and syntax linters into Batteries.Linters. It is ready for review and discussion.

This is relevant for #batteries > unused anonymous argument. While not directly conflicting, whichever of batteries#1830 and batteries#1879 gets merged first is likely to throw a monkey wrench to the other.
(I also have some in-flight PRs for isAutoDecl)
Does this change any code, or just move it around? (It's a bit hard to read the diff)
No changes in code, just some moving around files and name edits. It's just a relatively complicated one that took several days to cook.

I think the main issue is to negotiate the order of operations. I'm happy to build the consolidation PR on top of other high-priority PRs like batteries#1879. Of course, this causes delays and mild frustration since I was so happy to finally be done with batteries#1830 earlier today. There's also a chance that I accidentally mess up merging batteries#1879. The other way around is possible but I think batteries#1879 needs to be merged soon.
What I just said resolves the primary issue: batteries#1879 goes first.
Can batteries#1863 also be merged before this one? Less code to move around :-)
@Michael Rothgang The mathlib adaptation for batteries#1863 has been reviewed and delegated. Could you merge it quickly since it is currently blocking the Mathlib test on Batteries.
I won't be at a computer until Sunday evening, sorry. I can merge it then.
I just sent the PR to bors (from train wifi).
